windows_app.root_cause_found: ICoreWebView2Controller is a BORROWED reference inside the completed handler. Storing it without AddRef let the runtime destroy it as soon as Invoke returned, which per MS docs closes the WebView. Hence: Navigate returned S_OK (called inside the handler) but no navigation event ever fired and nothing painted (black window); later puts (put_Bounds on WM_SIZE, the watchdog state dump) dereferenced freed memory -> 0xC0000005 crash. Fixed in 1.0.3 with controller->AddRef().
v103_changes: controller->AddRef() before storing it; Released in TearDownWebView()
LogWebViewState only trusts out-params whose call returned S_OK
